info.about: Wendy: Every Witch Way is an action platform video game published by TDK Mediactive and developed by WayForward Technologies for the Game Boy Color in 2001. The game centers on Wendy the Good Little Witch from the Casper the Friendly Ghost series.
info.why: TDK Mediactive released it in North America in November 2001, months after the Game Boy Advance launched, so very few cartridges were printed.
